items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: At the Berlin Jazz Festival around nineteen sixty nine or seventy, Thelonious Monk was there and Kenton’s band was also on the bill, and Monk overheard somebody, who’ll remain nameless, putting down Kenton; a white guy as it happened. Monk turned to the guy and said: “what’ve you done compared to what he’s done?”
There’s Kenton music you can like or dislike.
